title: Compass and Escarpment
author: Gideon Coldharbour
blurb: Casper Whitlock, a salvage diver working a wreck the navy won't discuss, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must cross the range ahead of the snows before the glacier calving season opens the route — briefly.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
